games.title: PixelPipe Test
games.description: Original NES homebrew written for PixelPipe (CC0). A yellow cursor moves 3 pixels per frame with the D-pad. A flashes the field red and recolors the cursor. Holding a direction raises the square-wave pitch. The background pulses so a live frame is obvious.

games.title: PixelPipe SNES Test
games.description: Original SNES LoROM written for PixelPipe (CC0). A blue field and a yellow sprite. Right moves the sprite two pixels per frame. Snes9x supplies the audio samples.

games.title: PixelPipe Genesis Test
games.description: Original Genesis ROM written for PixelPipe (CC0). A blue field and a yellow sprite. Right moves the sprite three pixels per frame.
